svg.title: A Particula-based model reduces mean error in three- hour dust median diameter by 37%
svg.desc: Wind-tunnel schematic with airflow, airborne dust and a floor tray. Across the four winds, the predicted median diameter of dust retained on the trays at three hours missed the measured median by an average of 4.48 µm when the 30-minute median was carried forward and 2.84 µm with Particula-based transport and retention. The largest improvement occurred at 6 m/s.
